pages.text: With the Engineer's Mallet, you're able to replicate the Engineer's technological minions.
These robotic creatures cannot be moved nor healed without the use of potions, certain spells and the mallet itself.

An intelligent targeting dispenser that rapidly shoots arrows towards any creature that wishes harm upon their creator. After rapidly shooting around 75 arrows, they have a chance of overheating and are unable to attack for around 9-10 seconds.

Named as to hinder the efforts of foes, these sentries will heal any allied creature near itself. Unfortunately, $(l)they cannot heal the undead$() and will enter a period of cooling down after several seconds of healing.
As its name suggests, the factory constantly churns our tiny servants that are either explosive, capable of flying and shooting arrows or tiny illager-like robots that poke at enemies.
